advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Confirm coverage-gap BLOCK verdicts never carry advisory findings, or enumerate them in the coverage-gap message body so the body-guarantee holds on that path too.
evidence: adapter.py:187 `"findings": _translate_findings(verdict),` in _block() runs for every reason, including coverage gaps
adapter.py:159-177 the `scanner`/else coverage-gap branch of _summarize returns only the gap sentence and never calls render_findings_block
voter.py:712 passes `decision.get("findings") or []` to post_review regardless of gap_reason
finding_publish.py:14-16 states 'Every finding handed to post_review is enumerated in the message when it is not inlined' — an invariant the coverage-gap message body does not uphold
advisory.finding: On a coverage-gap BLOCK (gap_reason != 'finding': gate-disabled, llm-unavailable, scanner, indeterminate), the decision still carries _translate_findings(verdict) — including any advisory findings — into post_review, but _summarize's coverage-gap branch does not enumerate any findings in the message body. Anchorable findings on such a path would be posted inline while NONE are enumerated in the body, violating the module's 'body is the guaranteed surface' invariant for that path.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add a test that drives the real `GerritClient.post_vote` (monkeypatching `_request`) and asserts the posted body contains the `comments` map when non-empty and omits it when empty.
evidence: gerrit_client.py:326-330: `if comments:` / `body["comments"] = comments` then POST to `.../review`

All comments-bearing tests use fakes: test_review_bot_finding_publish.py:181 `def post_vote(self, change_id, revision, value, message, comments=None):` records but does not build/assert a real request body
search for `body["comments"]` / `robot_comments"` in tests returns (no matches) — the real body construction is asserted nowhere

ABSENCE: no test monkeypatches `GerritClient._request` and asserts the posted JSON contains a `comments` key when inline anchors exist (cf. test_review_bot.py:1252 which does monkeypatch `_request` for get_patch but never for post_vote body)
advisory.finding: The new `comments` body-inclusion branch in the real `GerritClient.post_vote` (`if comments: body["comments"] = comments`) is never exercised by a test. All tests that pass `comments` use a fake `post_vote`; no test asserts the real client places the inline-comment map into the POST request body, so a regression that dropped `body["comments"]` (the exact contract making inline findings reach Gerrit) would pass every test.
advisory.suggested_fix: Add a gerrit_client-level test: construct a real GerritClient, monkeypatch `_request` to capture the POSTed body, call `post_vote(..., comments={"a.py": [{...}]})`, and assert the captured body has `body["comments"] == {...}`; also assert `comments` is absent when passed None/empty.
